evals.prompt: Analyze three minutes of an authorized YouTube lecture for its argument and supporting visual evidence.
evals.expected_output: A focused brief with source ranges, visual evidence, and inspection gaps.
assertions: The brief identifies the inspected source interval.
Visual claims link to inspected frames.

evals.prompt: Capture three minutes of an authorized YouTube live stream and analyze completed segments while capture continues.
evals.expected_output: Bounded capture, retained segments, measured processing delay, and provisional findings.
assertions: The source state is recorded before capture.
Unresolved original-track provenance is reported without a false original-track claim.
Near-live overlap is reported only when supported by observed processing times.

evals.prompt: Explain only the music and editing in this silent-text video excerpt.
evals.expected_output: Direct modality inspection or explicit capability limits, without invented speech evidence.
assertions: Unavailable direct audio inspection is disclosed.
No transcript is presented as evidence of music or editing.
